answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond in a lotus escrow before it can earn; peers acting as raven auditors may challenge any identity they suspect of duplication, and challenged identities must pass an interactive liveness-and-work proof within a day or forfeit the bond to the challenger. Spreading thousands of fake identities across the tundra of the network then costs the attacker a linear fee per identity, while honest auditors spend only per challenge — sybil farming becomes unprofitable.
